Bring ablation results draft for discussion. --- ## ICLR Reviewer 2 Response - **Issue:** Lack of rewrite vs. naive‑append comparison. - **Action:** Include ablation results from Item 3 in the revised paper. - **Draft Response:** see table above. --- ## Workshop & Lab Meeting - **Workshop (a7676b97)** – outline expanded to include ablation (0874d215). - **Lab Meeting (966750cc)** – present preliminary consolidation implementation plan. --- ## Overnight Idea - **Overnight idea:** Leverage MemGPT’s virtual paging (cbddd6cc) to implement the consolidation baseline, allowing the rewrite advantage to be isolated from external memory scaling effects.
